results.why: Manganese comes from rock and soil. It can stain fixtures black; high levels are a concern for infants.
results.fix_if_high: Oxidation/filtration (greensand) or a water softener rated for manganese; reverse osmosis for drinking water.

results.why: Lead in well water usually comes from pipes, solder and well parts, not the rock, so it varies house to house.
results.fix_if_high: Point-of-use filter certified to NSF/ANSI 53 for lead; replace old brass fittings or lead solder where possible.

test_plan: Bacteria (total coliform / E. coli) - every year and after any flooding, for every well.
Manganese - priority for your area (elevated risk).
Lead - test at least once; it depends on your home's plumbing.
Arsenic - include in a standard metals/nitrate panel every 2 years.
Nitrate - include in a standard metals/nitrate panel every 2 years.
How: contact Wake County Environmental Health to order a test through the NC State Laboratory of Public Health, or use a state-certified private lab.
disclaimer: This is an estimate for your area, not your well. Only a lab test tells you what is in your water.
